concept: A paint-shop colour fan deck for one made-up logo, rendered in 3D (Blender) on plum paper: five leaves on a steel rivet. Shut and seen close, its top leaf answers the question in one word: Purple. From above it fans open, and the same word is on five different purples (the logo, the van, the sign, the website, the uniform). Close on the open fan, focus comes forward to the top leaf, which now gives its code, #5B2A86, with 'This purple.' printed across the colour itself. The top leaf is graded to measure its own code. Plum, five purples, card white, steel, a serif with one lilac italic word.
